librarygames/dungeon/Crawl.xtl

The dungeon's rules, a library: dungeon.xtl (scripted), play.xtl (the game: arrow keys) and the web page all use these. Built on lib/Ecs: a world is a matrix, a row per entity, and every rule is a system, one expression over every entity with the components it needs. You, the monsters and the things to pick up are entities; what each one is comes from its components (dungeon.toml gives each kind its own), so a new kind of monster or item is a new table there, not new code here. A game's state is a tuple: (the world, the gold found, the turns taken, what just happened, the map it is played on). Each new game picks a map and places you, the way out, the monsters and the items on its floor at random, from its seed.

source · imports ec: lib/Ecs.xtl lib/Ecs.xtlm; sv: lib/Svg.xtl; t: lib/Text.xtl

ʰw̲orld : Int -> Float

function (private) · line 22

The layout: where it is, how much it can take and how hard it hits, its kind, whether it comes after you, and what it gives when picked up (or drops when beaten), you, and the way out.

"h" ᵉᶜc̲omponents< "pos:2 hp atk kind chase heal gold player goal"
ᵉᶜc̲omponents< expands to
ʰw̲orld ← { n → (n c̲at 20) r̲eshape 0.0 }
ʰp̲os ← { W → (3 4) s̲elect₂ W }
ʰh̲asPos ← { W → 0 < 2 s̲elect₂ W }
ʰs̲etPos ← { W (ids, v) →
  i ← r̲avel ids
  V ← (((t̲ally i) c̲at 1) r̲eshape 1.0) c̲at₂ ((t̲ally i) c̲at 2) r̲eshape v
  R ← f̲loat (r̲ange t̲ally W) '= t̲able i
  C ← f̲loat (2 3 4) '= t̲able r̲ange 20
  M ← 0 < R '+ '× i̲nner (((t̲ally i) c̲at 3) r̲eshape 1.0) '+ '× i̲nner C
  (W × f̲loat n̲ot M) + R '+ '× i̲nner V '+ '× i̲nner C
}

ˡn̲ew : (Any a, Num b, Num c) => a -> (Float, b, c, Char, Int)

function · line 54

A new game on a map drawn at random: you on a random floor cell, the way out on the floor cell farthest from you, and the map's monsters and items (it says how many of each kind) on random floor cells at least 4 steps from you; every entity given its kind's components, all at once (a kind with no heal has no heal component, and so on).

ˡn̲ew ← { x →
  lv ← r̲oll! maps
  g ← ʰg̲rid lv
  ents ← w̲here g m̲ember? glyphs
  kk ← glyphs i̲ndexOf ents s̲elect g
  floor ← w̲here g ≠ f̲irst "#"
  order ← (g̲rade r̲oll! (t̲ally floor) r̲eshape 1000000) s̲elect floor
  me ← f̲irst order
  goal ← f̲irst (g̲rade n̲eg me ʰs̲teps floor) s̲elect floor
  far ← ((4 ≤ me ʰs̲teps order) ∧ order ≠ goal) r̲eplicate order
  at ← me c̲at goal c̲at (t̲ally ents) t̲ake far
  (W, ids) ← (ʰw̲orld 32) ᵉᶜs̲pawn t̲ally at
  W ← W ʰs̲etPos (ids, f̲loat o̲\ (2 c̲at t̲ally at) r̲eshape ((at − 1) d̲iv 25) c̲at (at − 1) m̲od 25)
  W ← W ʰs̲etGoal (2 s̲elect ids, 1.0)
  mob ← ((r̲ange t̲ally ids) ≠ 2) r̲eplicate ids
  k ← 1 c̲at 1 + kk
  W ← W ʰs̲etKind (mob, f̲loat k − 1)
  W ← W ʰs̲etPlayer (f̲irst ids, 1.0)
  W ← W ʰp̲utSome (mob, k, HP, 1)
  W ← W ʰp̲utSome (mob, k, AT, 2)
  W ← W ʰp̲utSome (mob, k, CH, 3)
  W ← W ʰp̲utSome (mob, k, HE, 4)
  W ← W ʰp̲utSome (mob, k, GO, 5)
  (W, 0, 0, "Find the way out (>). Arrow keys or WASD to move; walk into a monster to fight.", lv)
}
Used in: s, games/dungeon/dungeon.xtl:39, ᵘl̲oop, games/dungeon/play.xtl:37

ʰp̲utSome : Num a => Float -> (Int, Int, Float, a) -> Float

function (private) · line 81

Component c (1 hp, 2 atk, 3 chase, 4 heal, 5 gold) for the entities ids whose kind k gives it a value above 0, every one at once.

ʰp̲utSome ← { W (ids, k, v, c) →
  x ← k s̲elect v
  on ← w̲here x > 0
  c = 1 ? W ʰs̲etHp (on s̲elect ids, on s̲elect x)
